what_this_is: The authorization surface for any LIVE run against the checkpoint candidate. Nothing in it has been run. It exists so a later authorized session does not have to re-derive the candidate's identity or re-choose a case set.

budget.rule: No provider call may be made until a human fills these in.

baseline.note: The Session 6 baseline arm at artifacts_canary/catalog_audit_session6_20260907/baseline/ is still valid for the 3.1-era comparison and should be reused rather than re-bought.

identity_rule: Both arms stamp catalog version 3.2. Identify a run by catalog_sha256 and the projection fingerprint, never by the version string.

operational_pins.LM_STUDIO_URL_note: Re-pinned from the Session 5/6 manifest's 169.254.83.107:1234, which is a stale link-local address (S6-6). The model identity is the routing invariant and must be verified at run time.
operational_pins.embeddings_sidecar: http://127.0.0.1:8081/v1, jina v5 small text-matching Q8_0, dim 1024
operational_pins.embeddings_readiness: probe with a real POST; /health has returned 200 while every call failed
operational_pins.pass_2d_model_note: Pass 2d runs on the local Qwen model in production, not the Terra-tier GPT (S6-8).

candidate_live_questions.question: Do the 33 bathroom rows that lost the generic wallpaper item resolve acceptably once Pass 2d re-runs?
candidate_live_questions.why_offline_cannot_answer: The rows keep a full candidate list and the model chooses among them; the offline instrument settles retrieval, not selection.
candidate_live_questions.cheapest_instrument: Pass 2d x5 on exactly those 33 rows, local model, no Terra unless a new BILLABLE landing appears.
candidate_live_questions.accepted_without_it: Yes, under decision D4: the residual was disclosed and accepted unmeasured.

candidate_live_questions.question: Do the trim conditions display at $0 and stop billing in a live run?
candidate_live_questions.why_offline_cannot_answer: Disposition depends on the live Terra verdict.
candidate_live_questions.offline_derivation: Recomputing decide_disposition on the Session 6 stored verdicts against the new route yields no_action/$0 for all three trim landings. A derivation from stored verdicts, not a reuse: the request fingerprints differ.
candidate_live_questions.cheapest_instrument: The Session 6 Stage A case set, candidate arm only.

candidate_live_questions.question: Fresh Sol decisions for packages whose support list changed.
candidate_live_questions.note: This is also the Catalog 3.2 acceptance data still owed (S6-7). It needs whole-property runs, not a condition subset.

benchmark.note: Scoring needs a Pass 2d model call. --gates will accept it because it is frozen.

stop_conditions: any provider call before the budget fields are filled in
any run that would mutate a stored artifact or a production checkpoint
Stage B without its own separate authorization
